content.thinking: Clicking through all eight buttons revealed failures in three sections: B throws an unhandled promise rejection ("Request aborted"), while D and F throw uncaught TypeErrors about missing retry settings on their jobs; A, C, E, G, and H work fine. I caught these via page-level error listeners since the console itself stayed silent, waiting 1.5–2.5 seconds per click—though slower errors could still be missed or misattributed.

input.notes: Added error/unhandledrejection listeners, clicked each button one at a time, and waited 1.5-2.5 s after each click. B: 'Request aborted' rejection. D and F: TypeError 'Cannot read retry settings'. The browser console was empty, so these results come from the listeners only.
